description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Consulate General Office in Chengdu, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Consulate General Office, established in Chengdu, China on 2009‑12‑15, has been closed with effect from 2016‑06‑30, with the approval of the Cabinet, due to financial and resource constraints that arose at that time. During the State visit of the President to China in January this year, the matter of reopening the said Consulate General Office was brought to the attention of the President during the deliberations held with the authorities of the Sichuan Province. Accordingly, having observed the geopolitical significance, economic potential, industrial and technological advancement, large-scale industries and trade and economic relations of the Sichuan Province, it has been recognized that the reopening of the Sri Lanka Consulate General Office in Chengdu will provide an opportunity to further enhance the existing friendly relations and cooperation between the two countries in the political, socio-economic and cultural fields. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to reopen the Sri Lankan Consulate General Office in Chengdu, China was approved by the Cabinet.
